summary: The reviewed installer and bridge contain a narrow exact-GM, preview-token, native Foundry document write path, but the current RuntimeProfile deliberately reports write capabilities unavailable and the fixture supervisor does not instrument native document writes or post-restart world persistence. M1181 therefore remains fixture-memory create/readback evidence; persistent-world promotion is not proven and cannot be inferred.

databaseFirst.reconciliation: The approved read-only boundary was followed; no fixture, browser, staging, served GET, installer, document, asset, Scene, raw storage, authority, player, Ballad, Stage 12, or Ready-to-Play action occurred.

installer.scope: The candidate path is fixed to m1141-signal-rune, exact Foundry 14.367, dnd5e 5.3.3, elected active GM, and reviewed package assets; foreign semantic conflicts block and are preserved.

bridge.transport: Fixed bridge operations expose preview and approved install/repair only after exact world, settings, active-GM, and short-lived preview-token gates.
bridge.candidateWriteControl: Separate package-owned DialogV2 preview/approval control; no caller selector, document ID, payload, or arbitrary script input.

runtimeProfile.readOnlyApi: game.diceboxCampaignHelper.execute() returns NOT_READY; the RuntimeProfile remains non-mutating and non-authoritative.

worldDocumentWrites.basis: baseReceipt initializes worldDocumentWrites to 0; no native Foundry write hook, counter increment, or post-restart persistence reread is implemented in the supervisor.

balladTouched.basis: The value is a supervisor receipt field, not proof of persistent-world commit or native document write accounting.

decision.reason: The code path can call native Foundry writes, but current runtime capability evidence and supervisor receipts do not establish that an approved candidate write was committed to persistent world storage or survived a restart. Same-process collection reread is insufficient.
decision.nextBoundary: M1186: separately authorize one exact-fixture persistent-world proof boundary with explicit native-write accounting and post-restart authoritative reread; retain Signal/Rune-only scope, manual Gamemaster entry, blank password, foreign preservation, no Tram/Core/player/Ballad, and readyClaim false.

remainingBlockers: Persistent-world commit and post-restart authoritative reread are not proven.
Supervisor worldDocumentWrites is a non-instrumented default and cannot be used as write-proof evidence.
RuntimeProfile write and execution capabilities remain unavailable or unknown by design.
Tram/Core final-map scope, Regionwright/player behavior, player acceptance, Stage 12 acceptance, and Ready-to-Play remain unclaimed.
